title: Running time on overflow
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, choose one of $k$ work tapes, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word and $w$ a family of Boolean words on the work tapes. If fixed-width increment of the chosen tape's word overflows, then the increment machine started in its run phase from the configuration storing $w$ reaches the done phase with false verdict after some $T\le 2|w_i|+2$ steps. No earlier time $t<T$ is in either done phase, and at time $T$ the configuration is the one storing the same words except that the chosen tape contains $|w_i|$ false bits.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $k$ tapes
At every $t<T$, the machine is not in a done phase with either Boolean verdict
